audience: library staff who publish events, room bookings and appointments in Communico

useCases.title: List library events for a date range
useCases.text: List events between two dates, filtered by location, room, type, age group or tags. Read one event or a recurring series.

useCases.title: Review the registrants of an event
useCases.text: List the people registered for one event. Use this only for the library's own event administration.

useCases.title: Check study room reservations
useCases.text: List the bookable rooms of a location, and the room reservations between two dates.

useCases.title: Review booked appointments in a category
useCases.text: List appointment categories, then the booked appointments in one category for a date range.

useCases.title: Look up the library locations
useCases.text: List the library branches and read the details of one location.
